decision.observation: 14 mph, gear 1, one blue dot. The car has drifted left off the gravel and sits on grass about two car widths from the road edge; the road runs up-frame to its right, with the boulder meadow, pool and red building up-left behind a white fence.
decision.hypothesis: Only a short leftward drift this time, so a moderate W+D beat should put it back on the gravel without much speed cost at 14 mph.
decision.memory: Plain W at 6 mph rebuilt to 14 mph in one beat on this straight, and again the car slid left. Short W+D corrections work best from the left verge.
